fn has(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (has([1, 4, 6], 4) == true)
  example (has([1, 4, 6], 5) == false)
  example (has([], 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == x) or has(t, x)) }
}

fn at_pos(xs: List[Int], x: Int, i: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == (((i >= 0) and (i < len(xs))) and (xs[i] == x)))
  effects pure
  example (at_pos([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, 2) == true)
  example (at_pos([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, 1) == false)
  example (at_pos([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, 7) == false)
  example (at_pos([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, -1) == false)
{
  if (i < 0) then false else match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => if (i == 0) then (h == x) else at_pos(t, x, (i - 1)) }
}

fn search_ok(xs: List[Int], x: Int, r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == (match r { None => not contains(xs, x) Some(i) => (((i >= 0) and (i < len(xs))) and (xs[i] == x)) }))
  effects pure
  example (search_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, Some(2)) == true)
  example (search_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, None) == true)
  example (search_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, None) == false)
  example (search_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, Some(1)) == false)
  example (search_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, Some(1)) == false)
{
  match r { None => not has(xs, x) Some(i) => at_pos(xs, x, i) }
}

fn scan(xs: List[Int], x: Int, i: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires ((i >= 0) and (forall j in 0..(len(xs) - 1): (xs[j] < xs[(j + 1)])))
  ensures match result { None => not contains(xs, x) Some(j) => (((j >= i) and ((j - i) < len(xs))) and (xs[(j - i)] == x)) }
  effects pure
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, 0) == Some(2))
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, 0) == None)
  example (scan([], 3, 0) == None)
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 1, 0) == Some(0))
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 9, 0) == Some(3))
{
  match xs { [] => None [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then Some(i) else if (h > x) then None else scan(t, x, (i + 1)) }
}

fn binary_search(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires forall i in 0..(len(xs) - 1): (xs[i] < xs[(i + 1)])
  ensures search_ok(xs, x, result)
  effects pure
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 6) == Some(2))
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 5) == None)
  example (binary_search([], 3) == None)
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 1) == Some(0))
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 9) == Some(3))
{
  scan(xs, x, 0)
}

  ensures (result == (match r { None => not contains(xs, x) Some(i) => (((i >= 0) and (i < len(xs))) and (xs[i] == x)) }))
  effects pure
  example (search_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, Some(2)) == true)
  example (search_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, None) == true)
  example (search_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, None) == false)
  example (search_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, Some(1)) == false)
  example (search_ok([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, Some(1)) == false)
{
  match r { None => not has(xs, x) Some(i) => at_pos(xs, x, i) }
}

fn scan(xs: List[Int], x: Int, i: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires ((i >= 0) and (forall j in 0..(len(xs) - 1): (xs[j] < xs[(j + 1)])))
  ensures match result { None => not contains(xs, x) Some(j) => (((j >= i) and ((j - i) < len(xs))) and (xs[(j - i)] == x)) }
  effects pure
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, 0) == Some(2))
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, 0) == None)
  example (scan([], 3, 0) == None)
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 1, 0) == Some(0))
  example (scan([1, 4, 6, 9], 9, 0) == Some(3))
{
  match xs { [] => None [h, ..t] => if (x == x) then Some(i) else if (h > x) then None else scan(t, x, (i + 1)) }
}

fn evens_of(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures forall x in result: ((x % 2) == 0)
  ensures forall x in xs: ((((x % 2) == 0) and (count(result, x) == count(xs, x))) or (((x % 2) != 0) and (count(result, x) == 0)))
  effects pure
  example (evens_of([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [2, 4])
  example (evens_of([]) == [])
  example (evens_of([5, 7]) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if ((h % 2) == 0) then ([h] ++ evens_of(t)) else evens_of(t) }
}

fn odds_of(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures forall x in result: ((x % 2) != 0)
  ensures forall x in xs: ((((x % 2) != 0) and (count(result, x) == count(xs, x))) or (((x % 2) == 0) and (count(result, x) == 0)))
  effects pure
  example (odds_of([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [1, 3])
  example (odds_of([]) == [])
  example (odds_of([2, 4]) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if ((h % 2) != 0) then ([h] ++ odds_of(t)) else odds_of(t) }
}

fn is_maj(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((result and ((count(xs, v) * 2) > len(xs))) or ((not result) and ((count(xs, v) * 2) <= len(xs))))
  effects pure
  example (is_maj([3, 1, 3, 3], 3) == true)
  example (is_maj([1, 2], 1) == false)
  example (is_maj([], 1) == false)
{
  ((2 * occurrences(xs, v)) > length(xs))
}

  requires (len(rest) >= 0)
  ensures ((result and (forall x in rest: ((count(all, x) * 2) <= len(all)))) or ((not result) and (exists x in rest: ((count(all, x) * 2) > len(all)))))
  effects pure
  example (no_majority([1, 2], [1, 2]) == true)
  example (no_majority([3, 1, 3, 3], [3, 1, 3, 3]) == false)
  example (no_majority([], []) == true)
{
  match rest { [] => true [h, ..t] => (((2 * occurrences(all, h)) <= length(all)) and no_majority(all, t)) }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures not ((result and (len(xs) == 0)) and (r != None))

  example (majority_ok([1, 2], None) == true)
  example (majority_ok([1, 2], Some(1)) == false)
  example (majority_ok([3, 3], None) == false)
  example (majority_ok([], None) == true)
{
  match r { None => no_majority(xs, xs) Some(v) => is_maj(xs, v) }
}

  example (take_while_pos([1, 2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3])
  example (take_while_pos([-1, 2]) == [])
  example (take_while_pos([5, 0, 7]) == [5])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h > 0) then ([h] ++ take_while_pos(xs)) else [] }
}

fn take_while_pos(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) <= len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[i])
  ensures forall x in result: (x > 0)
  ensures ((len(result) == len(xs)) or (xs[len(result)] <= 0))
  effects pure
  example (take_while_pos([3, 1, -2, 5]) == [3, 1])
  example (take_while_pos([0, 4]) == [])
  example (take_while_pos([]) == [])
  example (take_while_pos([1, 2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3])
  example (take_while_pos([-1, 2]) == [])
  example (take_while_pos([5, 0, 7]) == [5])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h > 0) then ([h] ++ take_while_pos(h)) else [] }
}
